steps.title: The idea
steps.body: A queen and king can checkmate a lone king. The queen restricts the enemy king, and your king walks over to help.

steps.title: Restrict the king
steps.body: Black's king is in the middle. Move the queen to d7 to keep it boxed in.
steps.hint: Slide the queen up the d-file. Make sure the black king cannot capture it.
steps.success: Good. The queen controls many squares and keeps the king in a box.

steps.question: What should your king do?
options: Come closer to help the queen
steps.explanation: Your king is needed to finish the job. Bring it closer while the queen restricts the enemy king.
